entries.note: A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Preparing and explains as a parcel handed to the warehouse or handled there. It may come before any scan, so it says no more than registered; a scan staged accepted refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels In Transit and explains as anything from the handover to a carrier to customs and transport in the destination country, so a staged scan refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Undelivered and explains as a delivery attempt that failed.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Delivered.

entries.wording: Order information received. We're expecting your parcel to arrive with us.
entries.note: An order scan before Shouwu has the parcel.
An order scan, the first a parcel gets, before Shouwu has it.
Written two hours to the second after the order data on every parcel, days before the first facility scan: no one has the parcel yet, though the page's status turns In Transit with it.
Shouwu's warehouse taking the parcel in, which the page's Preparing status covers.
The warehouse done with the parcel before its flight, which the page's Preparing status still covers.

entries.wording: Shipment started the customs clearance process at destination

entries.note: Released by customs in the destination country.
A handover to the destination's delivery carrier, not to the recipient.

entries.wording: In transit along Poste Italiane’s logistic network

entries.note: The local courier's delivery round.
The local courier's delivery, after its round, with no place.
The local post's delivery to the recipient.
The first scan in the hands of the forwarder that takes the parcel to the flight, after the order data.
China's export declaration done before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
China's export release before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
The flight landed, a day after it left China; the tracker places it at "EU".
Released by customs in the destination country.
On the way to the airline, written with the export declaration and before the flight.
The local courier's round that did not deliver, after its out-for-delivery scan; the reason follows as its own scan.
The local courier's reason for a failed round, in angle brackets; the parcel went on in transit after it.
iMile's driver's reason for a failed round in Italy, in angle brackets, after its out-for-delivery row.
iMile, the delivering partner in Italy, receiving the parcel at its centre. iMile's sentences read its rows whatever centre they name.
iMile sending the parcel on to its delivery station.
Back at iMile's delivery station after the round failed, as iMile's map reads it.
After two failed rounds, the delivery station sends the parcel back to iMile's centre.
iMile closing the delivery order without a delivery, as on its own return rows.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at a carrier facility

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at an air hub
Shipment started the customs clearance process at origin

entries.wording: Shipment departed from a carrier facility
Shipment completed the customs clearance process at destination

Shipment has been sorted at the carrier facility

entries.wording: Your parcel has been prepared by your web merchant. It will soon be delivered to Colis Privé.
entries.note: Colis Privé's notice of the parcel's data, relayed before Shouwu's own scans; nothing has moved.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrived at the shipping partner. It will be sent to Colis Privé.
entries.note: Colis Privé's record of the parcel reaching the partner that brings it to France, relayed.

entries.wording: Your package is in transit to Colis Privé
entries.note: Relayed from Colis Privé before it has the parcel.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: DHL's first scan in Germany, relayed after the sort that follows customs at the destination.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the destination parcel center
entries.note: DHL's sort at the parcel centre that serves the recipient, relayed before its round.
DHL's round in Germany, after the destination parcel centre: no such recipient at the address, and the return follows.

entries.wording: Shipment will be returned to origin-Bad address
entries.note: DHL sending the parcel back after the round could not find the address: on its way back, not yet with the sender, as the Italian last mile's "Back to Sender" is.

entries.wording: Shipment sent directly from parcel center to business customer
entries.note: DHL's delivery from the parcel centre to a business recipient, "ab Paketzentrum dem Geschäftskunden zugestellt" in German. After DHL sent the parcel back, it is the return delivered to the sender: the parser reads it as returned.
The delivering partner's round in Germany.
Loaded onto a line haul's vehicle or a delivery round's, which it does not tell apart; seen after the out-for-delivery scan.

entries.wording: The shipment has been successfully delivered
entries.note: The delivering partner's delivery in Germany.
A hub on the way to the delivering carrier, after customs released the parcel at the gateway airport.
The delivering carrier's local branch, after the hub: the parcel waits there for its round, not for collection.
The delivering carrier's courier took the parcel at the branch, before its round.
The delivering carrier's round.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The goods' electronic data received, beside the order's own data row.
A partner's data row; one dated after the parcel moved reads as in transit.
A batch, named by its code, declared for the road to Hong Kong. Its pattern covers any batch code.
Arrived at the port of departure, waiting for a flight.
The flight booked for a day of the month, here the 23rd. Its pattern covers any day and the second leg's (二程) row.
The flight left.
The flight landed.
The second leg's flight left.
Landed; the parcel is being cleared and collected from the airline.
Import clearance done.
Handed to the delivering partner's depot and scanned there.

entries.wording: Your consignment has been picked up
entries.note: The delivering partner collecting the parcel from Shouwu's depot abroad, after the clearance. Shouwu had the parcel long before, so it is no handover from the sender.
The delivering partner's delivery in the Netherlands, after its out-for-delivery rows.

entries.wording: The goods have been deliverey to the final delivery service provider
entries.note: The hand-over to the last-mile partner after import clearance; "deliverey" is Shouwu's spelling.
The destination agent's receipt of the flight's notice of arrival, after the landing and before clearance.
Import clearance under way, before "Customs clearance has been completed".
Colis Privé's delivery to the recipient's letterbox, on the line into France.
A delivering partner's sort centre after the import clearance. Shouwu's own warehouse intake is "Arrival processing center".
The parcel leaving a delivering partner's sort centre after the import clearance.

entries.wording: The shipment could not be delivered. Please find more information here.
entries.note: A delivering partner's failed attempt; another delivery run follows. The link the wording points to is not relayed.
The order's data, written a second before "Shipment information received".
The delivering partner's data row, beside its "Shipment Announced", with Shouwu's 其他 (other) before it. Dated after the parcel moved, it reads as in transit.

entries.wording: The warehouse is currently processing the goods.
entries.note: The flying carrier's warehouse handling the parcel, days after it arrived there.

entries.wording: The shipment begins at the point of origin.
entries.note: Leaving the warehouse at the origin, seconds after its processing.
The flight booked, before the export clearance.

China's export clearance, a day before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
Import clearance at the destination, after the flight arrived.
The first scan after the order data, before the sorting center's inbound: the forwarder's warehouse taking the parcel in.

Item is in transit in European

entries.wording: Back to Sender for reason: wrong recipient address or address related problem

entries.wording: Failed delivery for reason: recipient was not at home

The destination's import clearance under way, a day after the flight's arrival.
The import clearance again, hours after the row that it is under way, without saying it is done; the next row schedules the delivery.
Shouwu's row after the import clearance, days before the delivering partner's depot and round: a delivery planned, not under way.
DPD's transit scan, as its German app words it, on the line DPD delivers.
DPD's delivering depot, before the round and again after a failed one.
DPD's delivery round.

entries.note: DPD's failed round with its reason joined, a wrong address. DPD's own map reads the sentence as a failed attempt whatever the reason, and the parcel went back to the depot, not to the sender.
